description: Transcribes speech from an audio (or video) file with faster-whisper, on the GPU when available. Output: transcript.txt, transcript.srt, transcript.vtt and result.json (language, segments with timestamps).

audio.description: Storage key of the audio or video file.

model.description: Whisper model size (default large-v3-turbo on GPU, small on CPU).

language.description: ISO language code (e.g. en, hi). Default: auto-detect.

wordTimestamps.description: Include per-word timestamps in result.json (default false).
